verdict.rationale: FreshBooks is an accounting SaaS with a public API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence covers OAuth, API endpoints, webhooks, a Postman collection and an SDK, but never mentions a sandbox, test-mode or developer account isolated from production data. A free trial is a different feature, not a sandbox, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
